headline: Congress has named a post office in Brawley, California, after Walter Francis Ulloa.
what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 401 Main Street in Brawley, California, as the Walter Francis Ulloa Memorial Post Office Building. It is an honorary designation and does not change how the post office operates. Mail service, hours, and staffing stay the same.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on January 4, 2025, and the naming took effect on that date.
